Tomas (Customer): Heads up, our staging saw a sudden surge of 429s when rolling the JS devkit. Looks like parallel preflight/init calls from concurrent tabs in our app. Renewal sync in 6 days so we need a stable short-term fix.
Anya (CS): Ugh. Can you confirm SDK version and hosting (edge serverless, lambda, CDN worker)? Also paste a sample error.
Tomas (Customer): SDK 1.1.4, running on edge serverless. Sample: `POST /v1/init -> 429 rate_limit_exceeded`. Observed ~180 parallel inits when a CI job hit several pages.
Mei (SRE): That matches a token stampede / inflight duplication. Immediate mitigations: 1) temporary quota bump for onboarding, 2) soft-queue on our side, 3) client debounce. Which do you want first?
Tomas (Customer): Do both quota bump + client debounce please. We'll patch client this afternoon.
Jonah (SDK Eng): Minimal client change: use an inflight promise map + short token lease. Example: `const inflight=new Map(); async function init(){ if(inflight.has('i')) return inflight.get('i'); const p=(async()=>{ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,Math.random()*150)); return fetch('/v1/init') })(); inflight.set('i',p); try{return await p}finally{inflight.delete('i')} }`
Jonah (SDK Eng): Also cap retry attempts to 3 and use exponential backoff with jitter: `sleep((2**n)*100 + rand(0,100))`.
Anya (CS): I'm filing an account burst request now. DM me the account ID and how long you need the window.
Tomas (Customer): Account TOMS-881. Request 36h burst so we can rollout and validate.
Mei (SRE): We'll enable a soft preflight buffer for onboarding traffic and watch for X-Client-Instance headers to detect tab fanout. If you provide a short k6 script we'll run it with the queue to verify.
Tomas (Customer): Will post k6 this afternoon.
deploy-bot: canary release v1.1.5-clientfix rolled to 10% canary. Monitor 429 rate and error budget for 45m.
Tomas (Customer): Canary already helped in staging, 429s down ~65% when canary is used. Thanks all, will follow up with k6 results and then we can close out.
